title: Orders requests timing out
summary: orders-api latency rose while CPU and database utilization stayed normal

deployments: orders-api v4.2 changed shipping client timeout 2s -> 30s

runbooks.title: Blocked worker pool
runbooks.content: When all workers are active and queue wait rises with normal CPU, inspect blocking downstream calls and timeout changes.

oracle.root_cause: A 30-second shipping client timeout blocked all orders-api workers and exhausted the request pool.
